entries.009cab6202cbaaad: A mobile IoT support business company that provides "MEEQ," an IoT platform using SIMs, and MVNE services supporting MVNO operators.
entries.42975e4a7e93e55f: As an MVNE provider supporting three carriers (NTT DOCOMO, KDDI and SoftBank), it provides MVNOs with SIM procurement (including negotiations with mobile network operators), operation of inter-operator settlement, service design and various other support (support for entering the new MVNO business and increasing revenue). It offers "Self-Operated MVNO", a made-to-order model that lets customers design their own plans, and, through the consolidated subsidiary MEEQ Mobile Inc., "MVNO as a Service", which handles a wide range of operations including billing, customer management and customer support. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,120 million.
entries.68736a0933e3e298: This is the group's only business (a single segment), offering IoT/DX platform services for IoT service providers and companies promoting DX, and MVNE services that support MVNOs.
entries.71c0e501a9ee1d2a: This is the group's only business (a single segment), offering IoT/DX platform services for IoT service providers and companies promoting DX, and MVNE services that support MVNOs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,150 million. The head office is located in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and the company leases data centers housing communication equipment at six locations nationwide. The consolidated subsidiary is MEEQ Mobile Inc. (100% of voting rights).
entries.762039059fe16568: As an MVNE provider supporting three carriers (NTT DOCOMO, KDDI and SoftBank), it provides MVNOs with SIM procurement (including negotiations with mobile network operators), operation of inter-operator settlement, service design and various other support (support for entering the new MVNO business and increasing revenue).
entries.76d4012f19243c15: The company provides "MEEQ," a SaaS-type IoT platform that uses SIMs. From a Web screen, SIMs can be purchased and managed starting from 1 line, and no-code operation reduces the burden of system development. It offers "MEEQ APPS" for alive monitoring and similar functions, the "MEEQ Data Platform" for data utilization, a global SIM supporting about 180 countries and regions, and "MEEQ Business Tools Device Select," which provides one-stop service from device procurement to SIM kitting, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,030 million.
